app.title: Wordle
app.description: Challenge yourself with the classic word guessing game. Play daily challenges, compete on leaderboards, try themed modes, and track your stats.

feedback.hidden: Feedback hidden until the game ends
feedback.legend: ✓ Correct position · • Different position · × Not in the word

modes.daily: One ranked game per language each day. Start begins the timer, which keeps running while you are away. Finish before midnight in the game time zone. A connection is required to start and submit guesses.
modes.practice: Unlimited practice rounds without a ranked timer or leaderboard points. After the app and word lists have loaded online, cached practice can work offline; the first visit needs a connection.

game.hintConfirmTitle: Do you want to enable hints?
game.hintConfirmDesc: You'll be able to see the word's definition.
game.howToPlayDesc: Guess the word in 6 tries. Feedback uses color, symbols and text: ✓ correct position, • different position, × not in the word.
game.howCorrect: is in the word and in the correct spot.
game.howPresent: is in the word but in the wrong spot.
game.howAbsent: is not in the word in any spot.
game.hardModeFirstTime: Hard Mode: Revealed hints (green/yellow letters) must be used in all future guesses. Good luck!
game.hardModeLocked: Modes can only be changed at the start of a game
game.blindModeFirstTime: Blind Mode: All tile colors are hidden until the game ends. You won't see any feedback until you win or lose!
game.loadError: Could not load word. Check your connection.

daily.statsUnavailable: Statistics are temporarily unavailable. Your game result is saved.
daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.desc: A new word every day. Everyone gets the same word — guess it in 6 tries and compete on the leaderboard!
daily.loginRequired: You need to login to play the daily challenge.
daily.playTodayFirst: Play today's challenge to unlock the leaderboard.
daily.resumeTitle: Your daily game is in progress
daily.startRule: The timer starts when you press Start. Once started, it keeps running even if you close the page, disconnect, or switch devices. Time affects your score.
daily.resumeRule: Your timer has kept running while you were away. Resume continues the same game without resetting the timer.
daily.finishedRule: Today's game is complete. View your saved result; the timer and score will not change.
daily.statusError: Could not check today's game. Retry before starting or resuming.
daily.dayChanged: The game day has changed. Unfinished games from previous days can no longer be played. Review today’s game and press Start when ready.
daily.nextGameUnavailable: Could not check the next game time. Your result is saved.
daily.nextGameReady: The countdown has ended. Check today’s game; a new game starts only when you press Start.
daily.offlineRule: You are offline. Your timer keeps running. Your draft stays in this tab; guesses require a connection.
daily.pendingRule: This guess has not been confirmed. Keep the same word and turn until the server confirms it; retry sends only that guess.
daily.reconnected: Saved game refreshed. Review the board before submitting. No guess was sent automatically.
daily.rolloverRule: Finish before midnight in the game time zone. Unfinished games expire when the day changes and cannot be resumed. Each new day requires an explicit Start.
daily.saveError: Could not confirm the request. Check your connection and retry.

leaderboard.dailyExplanation: Today's highest game scores in the selected language.
leaderboard.weeklyExplanation: Points from all your wins in the selected language since Monday. Each player appears once.
leaderboard.monthlyExplanation: Points from all your wins in the selected language this month. Each player appears once.
leaderboard.totalTieRule: Equal totals are ranked by the earlier final win in the period; remaining ties keep a stable order.
leaderboard.title: Daily Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No scores yet. Be the first!
leaderboard.playFirst: Play today's daily challenge first to see the leaderboard.
